programme: North West London Pathology + South West London Pathology Pathology IT LIMS preliminary market engagement

sources.authority: Mirror of Find a Tender Service data

public_scope_facts: Future procurement is for a Pathology IT Laboratory Information Management System with implementation, migration, integration, training and support services.
The engagement is intended to understand market capacity, supplier capability, delivery approaches, implementation risks and commercial models.
The networks describe large-scale hub-and-spoke pathology, urgent and routine testing, specialist diagnostics, GP/community connectivity, digital pathology and automation.
The notice calls for resilient infrastructure and interoperability beyond traditional HL7, including EPRs, national systems, automation platforms and analytics tools.
Named disciplines include biochemistry, haematology, blood transfusion, microbiology, immunology, H&I, virology, cellular pathology, andrology, genetics and molecular workflows.
The future platform is expected to support clinical safety, standardisation, regulatory compliance and operational performance while enabling digital transformation and potential AI/ML use.
Interested suppliers are directed to complete an attached questionnaire and respond by 1 October 2026 at 12 noon UK time via Atamis contract reference C467704.
